program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u037/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            top = min(y for y, x in cells)
            left = min(x for y, x in cells)
            bottom = max(y for y, x in cells)
            right = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [[grid[y][x] for x in range(left, right + 1)] for y in range(top, bottom + 1)]
            objects.append((color, shape))
    objects.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    out = [[0] * sum(len(shape[0]) for _, shape in objects) for _ in range(max(len(shape) for _, shape in objects))]
    col = 0
    for color, shape in objects:
        for y, row in enumerate(shape):
            for x, value in enumerate(row):
                out[y][col + x] = value
        col += len(shape[0])
    return out
'''
